title: Degree-16 pure Tate target
statement: For every stable pair (g,n), H^16(Mbar_g,n;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8).

locators.evidence_note: The 2026 survey records degree 16 as predicted but open.

title: Smooth proper stack cohomology is pure
statement: H^k of a smooth proper Deligne-Mumford stack over C carries a pure Hodge structure of weight k.

locators.evidence_note: The survey states the pure Hodge structure convention for smooth proper stacks.

notes: Shows that only the Tate-type condition is nontrivial.

title: Low even degree cohomology is Tate through degree 14
statement: For all stable (g,n), H^k(Mbar_g,n;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-k/2) for even k<=14.

locators.locator: Theorem 1.5(3) and discussion immediately after it
locators.evidence_note: Low even homology is tautological and duality gives the Hodge structures.
Earlier pure Hodge-Tate result through degree 12.

title: Boundary exact sequence reduces compactified cohomology to the open pure-weight quotient
statement: The boundary long exact sequence yields a right-exact reduction from boundary homology to H_k(Mbar_g,n), with quotient W_{-k}H_k^BM(M_g,n).

locators.evidence_note: This is the exact sequence used for the low-homology induction.

notes: A proof packet must track homology/cohomology duality and Tate twists explicitly.

title: Finite base-case inequalities for low homology
statement: In the low-homology induction at degree k, only n=0,1 with k>=2g or n>=2 with k>=2g-2+n require open-stratum base cases.

locators.evidence_note: The proof states the vanishing ranges and the complementary finite cases.

title: Published CKgP marking bounds through genus 7
statement: M_g,n has CKgP and tautological Chow ring for n<=c(g), where c(3)=11,c(4)=11,c(5)=7,c(6)=5,c(7)=3; genus 0 is unrestricted.

locators.evidence_note: Records c(g) and derives algebraicity of the pure-weight cohomology.
Primary source for most low-genus CKgP ranges.

notes: The degree-16 boundary of these ranges produces four pointed exceptional cases and genus 8.

title: All even cohomology in genus 1 is tautological
statement: For every n, the even cohomology of Mbar_1,n is represented by tautological boundary classes.

locators.locator: Proposition 2.4 discussion and proof of Theorem 1.5(3)
locators.evidence_note: The genus-one even case is discharged separately in the induction.

notes: Upstream primary references must be added during full corpus expansion.

title: Genus-2 even cohomology through degree 20 is tautological
statement: For k<=10 and all n, H^{2k}(Mbar_2,n) equals its tautological subspace.

locators.evidence_note: The paper states the genus-two result for every marking number.

title: Degree 16 remains open as of May 2026
statement: The universal pure-Tate statement is known through even degree 14, while degrees 16,18,20 remain open.

locators.evidence_note: Current survey explicitly records the open degrees.
The 2024 paper presents these degrees as predictions.

notes: Prevents spending effort reproving a later theorem without first finding it.

title: Candidate finite obstruction for degree 16
statement: Extending the published low-homology induction to degree 16 reduces the unresolved open input to W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), expected Tate type Q(8), for (g,n)=(3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,0),(8,1),(8,2). If d=3g-3+n, Poincare duality realizes this as W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d); the untwisted ordinary group has Tate type Q(-(d-8)) and Chow codimension d-8.
